checks: All 160 D paths were recorded and all execution gates passed.
The four diagnostic identities were reconstructed from pinned B/C outcomes and matched the predeclared manifest.
Each D prefix and swap step matched the first pinned B/C empty-inventory action disagreement.
No D path used more than one source action, and every post-swap action used the adapted actor.
Independent Decimal recomputation differed by at most 2.0386450600239897934161657218250469E-16.

mathematics.assertion_tested: Evaluate D on five frozen policy pairs and 32 natural starts per pair, and determine whether it recovers the four predeclared B-failure/C-success fixed-kernel paths.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Integer path/event counts; IEEE-754 rollout summaries; independent Decimal arithmetic at 50-digit precision for p=0 and p=0.05 expectations.
mathematics.conventions: One-indexed recorded steps; gamma=0.995; deterministic argmax actions; D swaps once at the first eligible post-handoff empty-inventory argmax disagreement and then uses the adapted actor.
non_claims: D is an evaluator-supplied rule, not a learned selector.
The four diagnostic cases were defined from pinned B/C outcomes before D execution; they are not a fresh generalization panel.
A successful one-action intervention does not identify a semantic bug fix or establish that the same action works in unseen states.

B/C agreement before the branch follows from identical initial states, deterministic transitions, and identical chosen-action prefixes; stored summaries do not independently encode every latent state field.
Exact p=0.05 values are finite-panel expectations derived from deterministic fixed paths, not stochastic-policy rollouts.
Five Dual-history learner seeds do not establish population frequency or significance.

residual_risks: The policy network and simulator were not independently reimplemented.
The same project codebase generated the paths and goal-success labels; path invariants and pinned comparisons reduce but do not remove verifier-designer coupling.
The four diagnostic paths were selected from prior B/C outcomes and are not an independent generalization panel.
Intermediate-probability values rely on the pinned environment property that any overwrite loss makes the goal impossible.
Schema version 1 does not machine-pin every execution input or resource limit.
result: Implementation and finite assertion verified: D recovered two of four predeclared diagnostic paths, with no new failure among paths B had solved.
